definition: Leukemic transformation of MPN (>=20% blasts). Most advanced stage of the continuum; molecularly distinct from de-novo AML.
notes: Encodes the myeloid progression continuum: chronic MPN (PV/ET) -> myelofibrosis -> blast phase. UNREVIEWED.

provenance.source: clinical-reference (WHO Ph-negative MPN classification; ASH/Blood + PMC on myelofibrotic and leukemic transformation)
